title: Epona: Autoregressive Diffusion World Model for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: Single-view (front camera) driving video generated autoregressively frame by frame at 512x1024, plus 3-second future trajectories.

control_signal.value: Predefined pose trajectory or per-frame action control, given alongside condition frames (history of 10 frames at test time).

control_mechanism.value: Action control MLP output is added to the timestep modulation of the next-frame visual DiT only, not the trajectory DiT (read from block diagram).

base_model.value: 2.5B model: GPT-style causal multimodal spatiotemporal transformer (1.3B), next-frame DiT (1.2B), trajectory DiT (50M); rectified flow; DCAE autoencoder; trained from scratch.

datasets.value: Trained on NuPlan videos and 700 nuScenes scenes; evaluated on 1628 NuPlan test clips and 1646 nuScenes validation clips; planning on nuScenes and NAVSIM.

metrics.value: FVD and FID for video; L2 error and collision rate on nuScenes, PDMS on NAVSIM for planning.

controllability_evidence.value: Qualitative only in packet: given predefined pose trajectories (turn left, turn right, straight), futures from different condition frames follow the path. No action-following number seen.

closed_loop.value: No external-policy closed loop stated. Self-rollout is autoregressive and minute-long: up to 2 minutes claimed, 140 seconds shown.

stated_limitations.value: Deep-compression autoencoder may add visual artifacts, so visual quality is slightly below MagicDriveDiT; plans to improve it. Model uses only the front camera.

notes: Action-injection detail inferred from Fig. 9 labels only. The FVD comparison text with MagicDriveDiT (94.84) and InfinityDrive (70.06) against Epona 82.83 looks inconsistent with its claim; not resolved from packet.
